estimate.method:
Each remaining phase's open work items and exit criteria were counted from runbook/phases/*.md, then sized item by item and calibrated against two signals.
(1) Estimates made before a research pass missed scope by about 4–5x. Phase 17 went from 5–8 days to about 275 h, which is 35–45 days unsplit (ADR-0072:13-19,50-53). Separately, "13 of 14 proposed freezes were refuted" (handover.md:151-152).
(2) Once scoped, execution has beaten the estimate unit by about 2x:
- Phases 0–12 were estimated at about 82 days and ran from 2026-08-05 to 2026-09-10 (RUNBOOK.md session-log dates).
- Phases 15 and 16, estimated at 2–3 and 2 days, took 2 and 1 active days.
- Phase 17 lanes L0–L5 merged in 2 days, and roughly 40–55% of phase 17's weighted work landed in 6 weekdays (a judgement). Exit criteria stand at only 3/10.
Phases that had a research pass (17, 17b) get about 0.5–1.0x the plan figure. Those that did not (13, 14, 18, 20) get about 1.5–3.5x, scaled by how much of each is new instrument work.
Calendar figures use two cadences: about 5 active days/week, observed since 09-28, and about 3.1/week long-run (12 git commit dates in 29 days, plus hidden squash days such as 10-02).
Markdown is at references/evaluation/status-audit-2026-10-06/estimate.md.

phases.rationale: 8 open work lines and 3/10 exit criteria (phases/17-breaking-window.md:61-232,257-283). Open: L6b (PR #35, opened 2026-10-06), ES-17, the ES-11/12 Neon fence spike (~16h per ADR-0072:53), ADR-0022 §9 with the guard-plan assertion, ProjectionId, codec, SQL-seam type, VT-6, and a 7-crate release with the semver trace table. The heaviest items (Busy ~20h, most of workerd ~26h) are done. Variance: the fence may fail ('ask again', handover.md:33), ES-17 may change append, and §9 may force a breaking change across two adapters.

0/7 exit criteria (17b-after-the-window.md:87-96). Research-estimated, so trusted with an execution discount. Tail risks: the minimal-versions job with its wasm32 leg (five DB crates declare no rust-version) and CF-40 MetadataLen across core, testkit and cloudflare with mutants.

0/6 exit and 0/13 work items, with 7 freezes and 3 rules plus mutants (18-typed-runner.md:21-192). The ADR-0074 spike settled the design but the build list is long: async apply across 12+ impls, the error type, on_error, a live savepoint test, the FNV-1a derived id with golden values, the fan-out runner with a benchmark, a refusable reset, Chunk, and the convergence declaration 13 consumes. Not research-estimated.

The 12 days is the pre-phase-16 monolith figure (RUNBOOK.md:5596); phase 16 then added 5 items and 17 freeze-by-13 rows without re-estimating (13-sync.md:10-17). 0/9 exit criteria. 0 of 35 SY rules are executable (32 daggered). Missing: SyncRunner, happenstance-sync-testkit, networked peers (only todo!() stand-ins, real_peer_shapes.rs:110-218), ADR-0026/0027, and the CF-25 portfolio check. Needs two unlike networked peers (L6a's workerd harness alone took ~4 days), plus the filtered-subset and KV-capped instruments. Raw sum ~36-66 days, discounted for execution.

1/5 exit criteria (14-retention.md:108-122). ADR-0028's refusal shrank the decision. Still to build: a removal capability on Fixture across 4 adapters, the completeness instrument (extending 13's filtered store), the reader experiment, the ES-38/ES-40 rules, and the SY-32 120-day case across peers.

Phase 21 depends on 20 (README.md:110), yet the roadmap does not count it (roadmap.md:81-82). 0/4 exit criteria and an empty session log. 3 unbuilt projects with 29 specified stories (.bklg/docs-that-teach: 8+10+11), plus confirming 3 projects left at review, at ~0.3-0.8 day per story. HS-P0024 needs readers who are not the author, which adds calendar wait beyond effort.

0/6 exit criteria. Work: choose release tooling, nine-crate PUBLISHABLE, SECURITY.md, MSRV text, rc.1. The soak has no time floor but needs all five ADR-0066 §8 conditions on the rc (21-one-point-oh.md:55-62): docs.rs for 9 crates, two examples against the registry rc, a clean semver baseline, an outside-reader pass, and no API-change defect (otherwise rc.N+1). Add 1-3 calendar weeks of soak on top of this effort.
Not in phase 21's dependency row (README.md:106,110). Runs alongside and competes for the same owner.
Off path. Its estimate is by analogy with phase 9 (19-sqlite-on-wasm.md:71-72). It is a candidate offline spoke for 13, but 13 does not require it.

Not in phase 21's dependency row and missing from the roadmap. 4/10 work items done; built but not deployed (Pages 404, waiting on the owner's setting at 22-docs-site.md:84). Its cost is owner attention: it already took a day inside phase 17 (PR #29).

estimate.total_roadmap: The roadmap says ~62-75 working days for the solo 1.0 path (roadmap.md:78). What remains by its own figures (17 remainder 19-24, 17b 8-10, 18 5-8, 13 12, 14 5, 21 3-5) is ~52-64 days. Both figures exclude phase 20, which 1.0 waits on, and the soak.
estimate.calendar_projection:
Central estimate ~90 working days on the 1.0 path, including phase 20 and excluding soak calendar time.
At the sprint pace seen since 2026-09-28 (~5 active days/week), 1.0.0 lands ~2027-01-08 (low), ~2027-02-09 (central) or ~2027-04-03 (high).
At the long-run pace (~3.1 active days/week: 12 git commit dates in 29 calendar days, plus squash-hidden days such as 10-02), it lands ~2027-03-06, ~2027-04-27 or ~2027-07-22.
Add 1-3 calendar weeks for the ADR-0066 rc soak.
Most likely window: late February to late May 2027.
0.4.0 at sprint pace: about late October to early November 2026.
Assumptions:
- Solo owner, with AI-assisted lanes keeping their observed throughput.
- No idle stretch like the one from 09-12 to 09-27.
- Phase 20's outside readers are recruited early enough not to gate the rc.
- Git active days understate effort, because squash merges hide working days.
scope_levers: Revisit D-1 (wi-40b321, roadmap.md:90-95): ship 1.0 as seven crates and put happenstance-sync on its own 0.x line. This removes phase 13 (22-40 days) and most of 14's SY-32 work, roughly 30-45% of what remains. The cost is that the freeze-by-13 rows on core and adapter surfaces (VT-6, VT-9, VT-21, VT-24, CF-40) need re-disposition by a record.
Defer phase 14 by renewing ES-39 past 1.0, which phase 14's own text permits because firing it is additive (14-retention.md:91-93). Saves 6-11 days, mainly if sync also leaves 1.0.
Take phase 18's recorded fallbacks: PS-30 fan-out outside 1.0 and PS-18 renewed (18-typed-runner.md:146-156), saving 2-6 days. Last resort: the runner exempt from semver at 1.0 (:172-173).

Narrow phase 20 to the single outside-reader pass phase 21 already requires, and drop the rest of HS-P0024/25 from 21's dependency row. Saves 5-12 days. Recruit outside readers now, because that wait is calendar time, not effort.
Timebox the ES-11 Neon fence spike and fall back to a named, documented exception rather than iterating. This caps the largest phase-17 variance.
Keep 19a/19b/22 off the path in practice as well as on paper (phase 22 already took a day inside phase 17); only the owner's Pages toggle is cheap enough to do now.
Levers 1, 2 and 4 together bring the path to roughly 30-60 working days, which puts 1.0 around December 2026 to February 2027 at sprint pace.
